name: Platinum Vape | 1g Live Resin Disposable | Trainwreck
description: Euphoric, fast-hitting, and energizing—Platinum’s P1 All-In-One Trainwreck packs legendary potency into a sleek, ready-to-use device. Expect sharp pine and sweet lemon flavor on the inhale, followed by a rush of cerebral energy and uplifting euphoria. Perfect for sparking creativity, social sessions, or powering through the day, this sativa classic delivers the heady intensity Trainwreck is known for—without the hassle of charging or setup.
